topic: Every Olympian has a coach. Yours is a prompt away. Five copy-paste prompts that turn an LLM into your operator's coach.

images.concept: Banksy stencil mural on a Saigon brick wall: 'GET A COACH.' in lime spray paint, large, sharp, slight drip. Sets the tactical, coaching-led tone of the post. Same approved style as the validated Banksy stencil sample.
images.prompt: A 16:9 hyper-realistic photograph, 1200x630. Shot on Sony A7IV with 35mm prime lens, f/4, natural late-afternoon daylight, ISO 200. Subject: An actual urban wall in a Saigon back-alley, with the phrase 'GET A COACH.' freshly sprayed onto the wall through a real cardboard military stencil. The wall is real weathered brick or concrete with visible age, water staining, peeling layers of older paint underneath, fine grit and dust along the base, scuffs from passing motorbikes. The spray paint is lime green (#ADFB49), with realistic photographic detail: visible spray particles, slight overspray haze on the wall around the letterforms, three or four small lime drips running down from the bottom of letters where the can paused. CRITICAL FONT REQUIREMENT: The typography is an authentic military or industrial stencil typeface (Allerta Stencil, Stardos Stencil, or Trade Gothic Bold cut as a stencil). Block sans-serif, all caps, geometric, monospace-feeling letterforms. Include visible stencil bridge gaps in O, A, and any other letters with closed counters (the small physical interruptions where the stencil cardboard had to hold the inner shape). The letters look industrially precision-cut, then sprayed by hand. The period at the end is a small solid square block. Photographic realism throughout: every brick, every drip, every speck of dust looks photographed, not illustrated. Late afternoon side-light from the right creates real shadow under any small wall imperfections. Background context (in soft focus from the f/4 aperture): two real motorbikes parked on the left, a Vietnamese shophouse with a paper lantern and signage on the right, a distant figure walking away in the deep background. Style: hyper-realistic documentary street photography, the kind of photo a photojournalist would take of an actual Banksy piece in situ. Mood: bold, observant, coaching, real, photographic. Colors: dominant jungle-dark wall and weathered Saigon brick warm tones, with lime green as the only saturated accent (the stencil text). Spell every letter of 'GET A COACH.' correctly. Include the period at the end. Avoid: ANY illustrated or painterly look, cartoon style, hand-drawn appearance, vector graphic feel, 3D-render plastic look, AI-art over-smoothness, hand-painted brushwork letterforms, calligraphic style, wonky or uneven letters, graffiti tag style, decorative typography, people facing camera or as focal subject, AI iconography, robots, glowing circuits, neon, cyberpunk, Blade Runner palette, purple, orange, red dominant, neural-net brain visuals, clip-art. No watermarks, no Western corporate stock aesthetic, no glowing circuits or robot imagery anywhere in the image.
